import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static int[][] pMat;
    static int[][] proMat;
    static int[] popcnt;
    static long[][] qArray;
    static int[] idxMap;
    static List<List<Integer>> groupsByCount;
    static Map<Pair, Integer> memoMap;

    static class Pair {
        int index;
        long state;

        Pair(int index, long state) {
            this.index = index;
            this.state = state;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return index == pair.index && state == pair.state;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(index, state);
        }
    }

    static int qpow(int base, int exp, int mod) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static int recurse(int index, long state) {
        if (state == 0) return 0;
        if (index == n) return 1;
        Pair key = new Pair(index, state);
        if (memoMap.containsKey(key)) return memoMap.get(key);
        int total = 0;
        int limit = 1 << n;
        for (int subset = 1; subset < limit; subset++) {
            long new_state = 0;
            List<Integer> groups = groupsByCount.get(index);
            for (int k = 0; k < groups.size(); k++) {
                if ((state & (1L << k)) == 0) continue;
                int c = groups.get(k);
                int nxt = subset - (subset & c);
                new_state |= qArray[c][nxt];
            }
            long prod = ((long) proMat[index][subset] * recurse(index + 1, new_state)) % MOD;
            total = (total + (int) prod) % MOD;
        }
        memoMap.put(key, total);
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        pMat = new int[n][n];
        proMat = new int[n][1 << n];
        popcnt = new int[1 << n];
        qArray = new long[1 << n][1 << n];
        idxMap = new int[1 << n];
        groupsByCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            groupsByCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        memoMap = new HashMap<>();

        int inv_100 = qpow(100, MOD - 2, MOD);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                pMat[i][j] = (int) ((long) val * inv_100 % MOD);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                proMat[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        proMat[i][j] = (int) ((long) proMat[i][j] * pMat[i][k] % MOD);
                    } else {
                        proMat[i][j] = (int) ((long) proMat[i][j] * (MOD + 1 - pMat[i][k]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            popcnt[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            int count = popcnt[i];
            groupsByCount.get(count).add(i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            int count = popcnt[i];
            int indexInGroup = groupsByCount.get(count).indexOf(i);
            idxMap[i] = indexInGroup;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 0) {
                    qArray[i][1 << j] = 1L << idxMap[i | (1 << j)];
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                qArray[i][j] = qArray[i][(j & -j)] | qArray[i][j ^ (j & -j)];
            }
        }

        System.out.println(recurse(0, 1));
    }
}
